ns2:course.label: Career Theory and Practice
ns2:course.description: Design and implementation of an innovative life planning process; a participatory experience that includes a survey of theories, models, and research on life and career planning and that encourages systematic skill identification, values clarification, and the development of job search strategies.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: On request, students will be required to participate in a total of 6 hours of experiments outside of class. Class Schedule Information: Required Course Materials: A set of inventories to increase self-understanding and awareness. Current cost for this inventory is $20 and will be charged directly to the student account.
